newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the news conference ending the Inter-American Development Bank and the European Commission donors conference on Guatemala would take place in the Centre Borschette at 1730/1630 GMT.
Van der Pas also said that Commissioner Karel Van Miert would hold a news conference on competition related issues at 1230/1130 GMT on Wednesday in the Breydel news room.

Asked about the Commission's reaction to the Italian Minister for Agriculture Michele Pinto's request for taxation facilities and aid for the milk sector suffering from the BSE crisis, van der Pas confirmed the arrival of a letter on this issue from the Italian Minister for Foreign Affairs Lamberto Dini. He said the Commission was studying the letter.

Spokesman Gerry Kiely also said Commissioner Franz Fischler had met Minister Pinto this morning. He said they had discussed how to help dairy producers and that Fischler had asked for detailed proposals to be examined in the context of the beef package and the Commission rules on state aid.

In answer to a question, van der Pas said he did not know why the two minutes of the Commission delibarations on gelatine published in the Belgian newspaper Le Soir were different from the ones transmitted to the European Parliament inquiry committee on BSE.

Spokesman Nicolaas Wegter said it had been decided at the General Affairs Council to send a fact-finding mission to Belarus and that he was therefore deducing that it was welcome there. Wegter said it would leave shortly but that he did not know the timetable yet.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/29: Environment Commissioner Bjerregaard presents the 1997 Commission work programme to the EP's environment committee.
- IP/97/30: Commission announces 200 mecus aid to Guatemala.
- IP/97/31: Customs: Commission introduces uniform system of checks on imports of bananas from third countries.
- IP/97/32: Commission communication to Council recommends further support for the International Science and Technology Centre (ISTC) through the TACIS programme.
- Speech/97/10: Summary of the speech by Commissioner Gradin at the European Parliament's committee on civil liberties and internal affairs.
- Speech/97/11: Speech by Commissioner Oreja at the European Union Confederation.
- Speech/97/12: Speech by Commissoner Kinnock on investing in sustainable mobility.
- Provisional agenda for Wednesday January 22, 1997's Commission meeting.
- Eurostat - Economy and Finance - ECU-EMS information and central bank interest rates No 1996-12.
